changelog:
- Initial release of xiaohongshu-publish, optimized for macOS with local Chrome GUI for stable, visualized publishing.
- Enables one-click publishing of notes (Markdown/HTML) as Xiaohongshu (RED) image posts, including automated extraction, rendering to 1080×1920 cards, and publishing.
- Provides step-by-step workflow: content extraction & image rendering → login (cookies) → MCP startup (local Chrome) → user confirmation → publish.
- Robust handling for macOS specifics: local Chrome login, cookie management, and image sorting.
- Clear troubleshooting and usage guidelines included to ensure publishing stability and prevent common errors.
